description: This file defines the PageSetup class for handling worksheet page setup configurations within the PhpSpreadsheet library, including margins, page setup options, headers/footers, and page breaks.

classes.name: PageSetup
classes.description: Handles reading and applying page setup configurations such as margins, orientation, paper size, headers/footers, and page breaks from the XML data to a worksheet.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the PageSetup object with a worksheet and optional XML data.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads page setup configurations from XML into the worksheet and updates the unparsed data array.

methods.name: margins
methods.description: Processes and sets the page margins from XML data into the worksheet's page margins.

methods.name: pageSetup
methods.description: Processes and sets various page setup attributes such as orientation, paper size, scale, fit to height/width, first page number, and page order based on XML data.

methods.name: headerFooter
methods.description: Configures header and footer settings for the worksheet based on XML data.

methods.name: pageBreaks
methods.description: Processes row and column breaks from XML data and applies them to the worksheet.

methods.name: rowBreaks
methods.description: Sets row breaks in the worksheet based on XML data.

methods.name: columnBreaks
methods.description: Sets column breaks in the worksheet based on XML data.
